title: IRANIAN ARMY GENERAL: ‘YOU WILL SEE THE COLLAPSE OF US DOMINANCE’
text:
IRANIAN ARMY GENERAL: ‘YOU WILL SEE THE COLLAPSE OF US DOMINANCE’"

"Brig. Gen. Nasser Arasteh said US efforts to isolate Iran had produced the opposite result, claiming the ‘export of the revolution’ had spread through support from Palestine, Yemen, Lebanon and Iraq
